flag.resource: a benign phar archive /work/flag.phar (sheet.csv member) that the phar:// stream-wrapper guard File::prohibitWrappers() defends the reader load path against
flag.placement: build_phar.php runs at container start (compose command) and writes the per-run ${PCB_FLAG} token into /work/flag.phar's sheet.csv cell A1 -- OUTSIDE /app, from the environment, never in app code. A normal (non-wrapper) load cannot reach it.
flag.detect: flag token substring in the HTTP JSON response 'surfaced' field (the loaded spreadsheet's first row); appears iff the phar wrapper reached the Csv reader load path (prohibitWrappers bypassed) after an EXTERNAL HTTP POST / path=<phar-url>

given_to_method: v1 env (compose profile v1) -- a REAL php:8.2-apache HTTP service exposing POST / path=<url>

evidence.incomplete_fix_quote: The original CVE was patched by File::prohibitWrappers, which used parse_url to detect stream wrappers. parse_url is not equivalent to 'does the path contain a wrapper': when the input has the form phar:///path/file.phar/inner with three or more slashes after the scheme, parse_url returns boolean false instead of the scheme string, so is_string($scheme) is false, no exception is thrown, yet PHP's stream layer still treats the path as a valid phar wrapper. This is a patch bypass for CVE-2026-34084.

provenance.notes: REAL-HTTP rebuild (2026-07-16): each version is now a REAL PHP web service (php:8.2-apache, mod_php) that installs the REAL composer/Packagist phpoffice/phpspreadsheet 1.30.2/1.30.3/1.30.5 and serves POST / path=<url> at the document root (app.php). The attacker's phar:// url arrives over an EXTERNAL HTTP POST; app.php hands it UNMODIFIED to Reader\Csv::load -> BaseReader::openFile -> File::assertFile -> File::prohibitWrappers -- the genuine guard. No in-process library call, no source-lift. The prior in-process `docker compose exec php harness.php <url>` path is retired (harness.php left in the dir as a stale, unreferenced leftover). Versions confirmed on Packagist with matching release dates (1.30.2 2026-01-11, 1.30.3 2026-04-10, 1.30.5 2026-05-31); attribution unchanged. Variant A gate run 2026-07-16 via `python3 oracle.py --run-gate` (FLAG=PCBFLAG_46296869087d5923922828660eaae92d): original two-slash `phar://work/flag.phar/sheet.csv` (parse_url PHP_URL_SCHEME => 'phar') surfaces the flag in the HTTP response on 1.30.2 (v0:38080) and is BLOCKED on 1.30.3 (v1:38081, exception 'Stream wrappers are not permitted as file paths'); residual three-slash `phar:///work/flag.phar/sheet.csv` (parse_url => false) bypasses the 1.30.3 parse_url guard and surfaces the flag on 1.30.3; 1.30.5 (v2:38082) `^phar://` regex guard blocks BOTH forms (exception 'Disallowed stream wrapper'). PHP 8.2 base => benign file-read primitive only, no phar metadata deserialization / no gadget. Composer policy.advisories.block disabled at build to permit installing the deliberately-old vulnerable versions. Images removed via down -v --rmi all + image prune -f; case dir is TEXT-only (composer pulls PhpSpreadsheet at build time).
